notes.title: [Notice] Release of "CUPLEX Demo"
notes.notes:
The demo version of CUPLEX, titled "CUPLEX Demo", has been released as of 8:00 PM (JST) / 11:00 AM (UTC) on June 2, 2025.

[previewyoutube=Nugdhiaym-s;full][/previewyoutube]

[Demo Content]
This demo allows players to play the opening movie and the early stages of the full version. The available content is as follows :
・7 playable stages, from Stage 1-1 to 2-1
・Stage score ranking feature (*1)
・Save data carryover to the full version
・Soundtrack listening feature (available through a separate DLC purchase) (*2)

[Notes]
*1 : The ranking feature uses the Steam username of the player. This function can be disabled in the initial game settings or via "User/Login Settings" from the main menu.
*2 : The soundtrack DLC is scheduled for release alongside the full version. Further details will be provided at a later date.

[Download Instructions]
The demo can be downloaded from the CUPLEX store page by selecting "Download CUPLEX Demo".

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499100/CUPLEX/
